description: Holdout registry for eval decks. The seed-side equivalent (eval-only seed bank + seed overlap check) is a separate artifact owned by the other workstream; this file covers decks/matchups only. Status semantics: 'in-corpus' = known to appear in training datasets, evals on it measure in-distribution play only. 'held-out' = must never appear in a training dataset except those listed in 'grandfathered' (contamination that predates the declaration is frozen, not hidden); evals on it measure generalization only for models whose training corpora are all free of it outside the grandfathered list (i.e. corpora built after the declaration).

painter.name: Painter
painter.notes: Declared held-out 2026-07-26. Contaminated in all corpora through stage2-local-v1-dagger (grandfathered), so it is a valid generalization deck ONLY for models trained on corpora built after that dataset. Exclude from all future corpus builds; eval/check_holdouts.py fails if it leaks into a new dataset.

sneak-and-show.name: Sneak and Show
sneak-and-show.notes: Declared held-out 2026-07-26. Same semantics as painter. These two decks are a default pick (one midrange-combo, one pure combo); swap for any other pair by editing this file, but never un-declare a holdout after a model has been kept clean of it.
